entries.en: Added `enforceAvailableModels` managed setting — when enabled, the `availableModels` allowlist also constrains the Default model (a Default that would resolve to a disallowed model now falls back to the first allowed model), and user or project settings can no longer widen a managed `availableModels` list
entries.zh: 添加了`enforceAvailableModels`托管设置 - 启用后，`availableModels`允许列表还会限制默认模型（将解析为不允许的模型的默认模型现在回退到第一个允许的模型），并且用户或项目设置无法再扩大托管`availableModels`列表
